description: The Multi-channel Visible and Infrared Scanning Radiometer (MVISR) was the primary optical imaging payload on FY-1D, featuring 10 spectral channels from visible to thermal infrared wavelengths. Its filters support cloud imaging, sea surface temperature, vegetation monitoring, and environmental hazard tracking.
facility_description: FengYun-1D was the fourth satellite in China’s first-generation polar-orbiting meteorological satellite series, operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
notes: Filter spectral response functions originate from the NSMC GSICS portal (http://gsics.nsmc.org.cn/portal/en/fycv/srf.html). Portal footer asserts Copyright © NSMC(NCSW).
